custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test at the test location.
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, with a line holding a part request for part A, not yet received, so part A sits on an open part request.
  • Use two new part numbers that no Part Library entry has, one exactly 51 characters long and one exactly 50 characters long.
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).

Setup

  1. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425614 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425614-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 1. Click Save.
  2. Make work order 1: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order. Pick any Customer and any Asset. Click Save. In the New Line window that opens, type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425614 LINE 1 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close.
  3. Request part A on the line: In the line's Parts row click + Add Part, then More options. In the New Part Request window type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425614-A in Part Number and pick the result marked Part Library. Type 1 in Quantity. Click Save Part. Do not receive it.
